first_step_test: One tall narrow rounded cylinder fixes the pole's final width, height, and upright axis while leaving the caps, stripes, bracket, and shadow absent.

source.notes: Planned as one six-panel cumulative graphite and restrained colored-pencil contact sheet; rejected iterations, if any, remain private under the slug draft folder.

final_elements.name: glass cylinder
final_elements.description: One tall narrow upright glass cylinder with softly rounded top and bottom edges.

final_elements.name: top and bottom caps
final_elements.description: One shallow metal cap attached at each end, one round finial centered above the top cap, and one rounded lower end nested below the bottom cap.

final_elements.name: three diagonal ribbon bands
final_elements.description: Exactly three broad diagonal bands wrapping consistently across the cylinder from upper left to lower right.

final_elements.name: wall bracket and round mount
final_elements.description: One short bracket attached behind the pole's right side and joined to one oval wall mount with exactly two round fasteners.

final_elements.name: two glass highlights and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly two narrow open-paper glass highlights and one broken graphite shadow beneath the pole.

frames.visible_job: Draws one tall narrow upright cylinder with softly rounded ends.
frames.instruction: Draw two long nearly parallel sides, then connect them with shallow curved ends to make one tall narrow cylinder. Keep its center upright and leave open paper around both ends and along the right side.

frames.visible_job: Adds attached top and bottom metal caps, one top finial, and one rounded lower end.
frames.instruction: Attach one shallow cap across the top edge and one across the bottom edge, following the cylinder's curve. Center one round finial above the top cap and one rounded end below the bottom cap, keeping every part on the same upright axis.

frames.visible_job: Adds exactly three broad parallel diagonal bands inside the glass cylinder.
frames.instruction: Inside the glass, draw exactly three broad parallel bands slanting from upper left toward lower right. Curve each band slightly as it meets the cylinder edges so the ribbon appears to wrap around the round form.

frames.visible_job: Adds one short rear bracket, one oval wall mount, and two round fasteners at the right side.
frames.instruction: From the middle-right back edge, extend one short horizontal bracket and join it to one oval wall mount. Stop the bracket line at the pole edge, then place exactly two round fasteners inside the mount so the glass stays clearly in front.

frames.visible_job: Adds two narrow glass highlights and one broken shadow without changing the structure.
frames.instruction: Place exactly two narrow vertical highlight gaps along the glass front, one high and one low, then sketch one soft broken shadow beneath the lower cap. Keep all three ribbon bands and the bracket fully readable.
adds: two glass highlights and broken shadow
introduces: two glass highlights and broken shadow

final_step.visible_job: Layers muted red, dusty blue, and cool gray only over established bands, caps, bracket, and shadow.
final_step.instruction: Alternate muted red and dusty blue through the three established ribbon bands, shade the two caps, finial, rounded lower end, bracket, and wall mount with cool gray, and deepen the same broken shadow. Leave both glass highlights open and add no new contours.

The cylinder, end hardware, three ribbon bands, bracket, two mount fasteners, two highlight gaps, and broken shadow retain their anchors; each transition matches its instruction, and the finish adds only restrained color and value.
